text:
```artifact
sequenceDiagram
    participant Patient
    participant Chemist
    participant Lab
    participant HospitalWebsite
    participant EmailService

    Patient->>HospitalWebsite: Access website via URL
    HospitalWebsite->>Patient: Display login page
    Patient->>HospitalWebsite: Enter credentials
    HospitalWebsite->>Patient: Authenticate user
    alt User authenticated
        Patient->>HospitalWebsite: Navigate to consultation page
        HospitalWebsite->>Patient: Display consultation form
        Patient->>HospitalWebsite: Submit consultation form
        HospitalWebsite->>Chemist: Send consultation request
        Chemist->>HospitalWebsite: Provide prescription
        HospitalWebsite->>Patient: Display prescription
        Patient->>HospitalWebsite: Confirm prescription
        HospitalWebsite->>Lab: Send lab request
        Lab->>HospitalWebsite: Provide lab results
        HospitalWebsite->>Patient: Display lab results
        HospitalWebsite->>EmailService: Send prescription email
        EmailService->>Patient: Deliver prescription email
        HospitalWebsite->>EmailService: Send invoice email
        EmailService->>Patient: Deliver invoice email
    else User not authenticated
        HospitalWebsite->>Patient: Display error message
    end
```
